parameters.name: CaCertificateBody
parameters.description: The content of the CA certificate.

parameters.name: CertificateName
parameters.description: The name of the SSL certificate.

parameters.name: CertificatePrivateKey
parameters.description: The private key of the SSL certificate.

parameters.name: ClientCertSDnPassThrough
parameters.description: If pass ssl_client_s_dn of the cert to backend header 'X-Client-S-Dn'.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the API group. This ID is generated by the system and globally unique.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi set-domain-certificate --group-id 927d50c0f2e54b359919923d908bb015 --domain-name api.demo.com --certificate-name test_cert --certificate-body -----BEGIN_CERTIFICATE-----_MIIEpAIBAAKCAQEA8GjIleJ7rlo86mtbwcDnUfqzTQAm4b3zZEo1aKsfAuwcvCud_...._-----END_CERTIFICATE----- --certificate-private-key -----BEGIN_RSA_PRIVATE_KEY-----_MIIEpAIBAAKCAQEA8GjIleJ7rlo86mtbwcDnUfqzTQAm4b3zZEo1aKsfAuwcvCud_...._-----END_RSA_PRIVATE_KEY----- --ca-certificate-body CA_certificate_encoding_content --ssl-verify-depth 2 --ssl-ocsp-enable true --ssl-ocsp-cache-enable true --client-cert-s-dn-pass-through true --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
